title: Search the audit log and export CSV
caption: Mirrors admin-audit.e2e.ts. Days are UTC; 'to' is inclusive in the form and exclusive (next day) in the API call.

steps.title: Open the OTA's audit
steps.body: Tab **Audit** → **Full audit log of this OTA**.
steps.expect: `/audit?tenantId=ten_…`; 'Choose a period (from and to) to export: at most one year.'

steps.title: Filter
steps.body: Set from/to days, actor type, action, target type, target id → **Search**.
steps.expect: Every filter in the URL; table 'Audit rows, newest first' with OTA, actor (kind + e-mail), action, target, request id, IP, browser, details JSON. A first day after the last shows a notice and calls nothing.

steps.title: Download
steps.expect: `velexis-audit-<from>-<day after to>.csv` with the same rows; a new `audit.exported` row appears in the log.
